dataset: Untergasser et al., RDML consortium: dPCR - DKFZ, DNA Dilution - AMC, Volumes and Machines

v1_bias.rule: LinRegPCR assay-mean efficiency, median |error| <= 0.15 log2 on >= 2 machines

v1_warning.rule: Spearman(spread, baseline |error|) >= 0.3 within each level with >= 8 cases

v2_coverage.rule: baseline 95 % interval with truth uncertainty contains the truth in >= 90% of cases
v2_coverage.method: robust (MAD) run effect, each plate group scored with components from the other groups

efficiency_calibration.rule: baseline 95 % interval with truth uncertainty contains the truth in >= 90% of cases
efficiency_calibration.method: log2 E_cal = log2 E_LinRegPCR + delta, one per-cycle offset for every run of a plate group: the median over the other groups' dPCR-measured dilution series of each series' least-squares offset; its SE joins the efficiency term; run effect as above
efficiency_calibration.preregistered: method and variants fixed before any calibrated number was computed
